item.title: Taking An Elevator To A Higher Calling
item.description: Read Taking An Elevator To A Higher Calling I worked for several years as a civilian contractor on a naval base. Our particular building had an auditorium used for various conferences. One day, as the elevator doors closed, I heard many sets of hurrying feet and 'Hold the elevator, please!', so I stabbed the Open-Doors button. Read Taking An Elevator To A Higher Calling

item.title: They Supersized Their Expectations
item.description: Read They Supersized Their Expectations Guest: "Where's the nearest McDonald's?" Me: "It's in the city centre. If you take bus number—" Guest: "No, I want one walking distance." Me: "There isn't, madam." Read They Supersized Their Expectations

item.title: My Days Of Not Taking You Seriously Are Certainly Coming To A Middle
item.description: Read My Days Of Not Taking You Seriously Are Certainly Coming To A Middle Me: "I've been going by my middle name my entire adult life." Coworker: "So… what's your middle name?" Me: "The name you've been calling me for the last three years." Read My Days Of Not Taking You Seriously Are Certainly Coming To A Middle

item.title: Romance Isn’t Dead, But It’s On A Deadline
item.description: Read Romance Isn’t Dead, But It’s On A Deadline I used to work at a card store. It's ten minutes before closing on Valentine's Day, and a guy rushes in and starts picking through our almost-gone holiday display. Customer: *Pointing at the display, looking disgusted.* "This is it?!" Me: "That's what's left of our Valentine's display that's been there for over a month, yes, sir." Read Romance Isn’t Dead, But It’s On A Deadline

item.title: Maybe Try In July To Enjoy A Certain Phrase…
item.description: Read Maybe Try In July To Enjoy A Certain Phrase… Me: "Sir, these are Christmas items." Customer: "Unwanted Christmas items." Me: "It's April." Customer: "That's why they're no longer wanted." Me: "Well… we don't want them either." Read Maybe Try In July To Enjoy A Certain Phrase…
